sentences.scenario: Repeat a sentence during Chinese class.
sentences.source_note: 00:46 correction: put 再 before 读 and use 一遍 for a complete repetition.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge zì kàn qǐlái hěn xiàng.
sentences.scenario: Compare two Chinese characters you confuse.
sentences.source_note: 43:28 correction; similar character confusion also occurred around 02:08.

sentences.chinese: 我需要准备明天的会议。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào zhǔnbèi míngtiān de huìyì.
sentences.english_hint: I need to prepare for tomorrow's meeting.
sentences.scenario: Explain a task before a work meeting.
sentences.source_note: Analysis vocabulary model corrects the learner's confusion of 准备 with 'suggest' at 28:26.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù tóngyì tā de guāndiǎn.
sentences.scenario: Respond to an opinion during a meeting.
focus: 不同意 + person + 的观点
sentences.source_note: Analysis drill 3; the learner repeatedly worked on expressing disagreement and distinguishing 同意 from 接受.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ dì yí ge fāyán.
sentences.scenario: Volunteer to speak first at a meeting.
sentences.source_note: 29:31 correction replaces vague 做 with the specific action 发言.

sentences.scenario: Explain to your child why you are busy.
sentences.source_note: 36:36 correction uses 正在上中文课; the learner's child interrupted the lesson.

sentences.chinese: 我希望我的孩子会说俄语。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng wǒ de háizi huì shuō Éyǔ.
sentences.english_hint: I hope my children can speak Russian.
sentences.scenario: Describe your wish for your children's language skills.
sentences.source_note: 40:36 correction: 希望 expresses the learner's wish, and 会 expresses language ability.

sentences.pinyin: Měi chǎng bǐsài wǒ dōu kàn le.
sentences.scenario: Tell a friend how much football you watched.
focus: 每 + measure word + noun + 都
sentences.source_note: 49:47 correction adds the match measure word 场 and 都; 每 constructions also caused difficulty earlier.

sentences.pinyin: Zuótiān nǐ kàn le bǐsài ma?
sentences.english_hint: Did you watch the match yesterday?
sentences.scenario: Ask a friend about yesterday's match.
sentences.source_note: Analysis drill 5 addresses repeated questions about completed viewing versus experience and ongoing viewing.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kàn guo Shìjièbēi bǐsài ma?
sentences.english_hint: Have you ever watched a World Cup match?
sentences.scenario: Ask about a friend's football viewing experience.
sentences.source_note: Analysis drill 5 contrasts 看过 with 看了 and 在看 after the learner's repeated aspect questions.

sentences.chinese: 我给你打电话的时候，你在看比赛吗？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà de shíhou, nǐ zài kàn bǐsài ma?
sentences.english_hint: Were you watching the match when I called?
sentences.scenario: Ask what your friend was doing during your call.
sentences.source_note: Analysis drill 5 gives this model for the learner's recurring question about 'were you watching.'

sentences.chinese: 我老板有二十六年的工作经验。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ lǎobǎn yǒu èrshíliù nián de gōngzuò jīngyàn.
sentences.english_hint: My boss has twenty-six years of work experience.
sentences.scenario: Explain your boss's experience to a colleague.
sentences.source_note: 57:23 correction and analysis drill 1: the learner repeatedly used 岁 for years of work experience.

sentences.scenario: Emphasize that a work question remains unanswered.
sentences.source_note: Analysis section 5 supplies this short model; the learner struggled with 连……都 and its word order.

sentences.scenario: End your Chinese lesson before a work meeting.
sentences.source_note: 01:08:23 correction: use the verb phrase 开会 when explaining the imminent meeting.
